how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-burning-steppes-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:3822:obj:0: Recover Sha'ni's Nose-Ring from Krom'Grul and return it to Thal'trak in Kargath. Search the various caves and mines in Dreadmaul Rock.⟦1⟧
rows.quest:3822:details:0: My whole platoon was captured, ⟦2⟧. All were slain - except me.
rows.quest:3822:details:1: BTheir leader, Krom'Grul, wanted to save me for some sort of ritual.
rows.quest:3822:details:2: BI was chained to this altar and brutalized by the beast. My physical being ceased functioning after an hour of this torture. The beast then ripped my wedding nose-ring off of my face and stuck it on his finger. I had never seen such savagery!
rows.quest:3822:details:3: BFind Krom'Grul and kill him! Take my ring back to Thal'trak.
rows.quest:3822:details:4: BAnd ⟦3⟧, tell him that we will meet again... in another life.
rows.quest:3822:completion:1: BWe were going to move to the Hinterlands. Did she tell you? This was going to be her last mission.
rows.quest:3822:completion:3: BI don't want it, ⟦6⟧. Keep it, throw it away, I don't care! The ring means nothing to me now. Not without her...
rows.quest:3823:obj:0: Slay 15 Firegut Ogre-Mages, 7 Firegut Ogres, and 7 Firegut Ogre Brutes, and return to Oralius when you are finished.
rows.quest:3823:details:0: We must strike at our enemies before they strike at us!
rows.quest:3823:details:2: BThe Firegut ogres of the ⟦E1⟧ are allies of the Blackrock orcs. They work closely with those vile orcs, keeping the mineral rich Dreadmaul Rock guarded and the supply lines open at all times.
rows.quest:3823:details:3: BLeave your mark, ⟦7⟧. Cripple their forces and return to me when the job is done.
rows.quest:3823:details:4: B<Oralius grabs at the air and makes a choking motion.>
rows.quest:3823:completion:0: Outstanding, soldier! The orcs and ogres will be reeling from this blow for minutes, maybe even hours!
rows.quest:3824:obj:0: Find Gor'tesh, somewhere to the west of Dreadmaul Rock. Kill Gor'tesh and then take Gor'tesh's Lopped Off Head back to Oralius in ⟦E1⟧.⟦8⟧
rows.quest:3824:details:0: They're reeling I tell you! Our next strike must be decisive.
rows.quest:3824:details:1: BThe brute lord, Gor'tesh, must be slain. More importantly, his head must be returned to me so that I may prepare the third phase of our attack on the Firegut ogres.
rows.quest:3824:details:2: BBe warned, soldier, Gor'tesh rules not from Dreadmaul Rock but from a Blackrock orc structure to the west of Dreadmaul Rock.
rows.quest:3824:details:3: BYour orders, then, are simple. Find Gor'tesh and chop off his fat head. Return to me when the job is done.
rows.quest:3824:completion:0: Just look at it, soldier. Disgusting! When the remaining Firegut ogres see this fat mug stuck on a pike sitting at the top of their mountain, mass hysteria will ensue!
rows.quest:3825:obj:0: Take Gor'tesh's Lopped Off Head and place it at the top of Dreadmaul Rock. Look for a soft dirt mound to plant the pike.
rows.quest:3825:details:0: Just one last thing you must do, soldier.
rows.quest:3825:details:1: BI've taken the liberty of putting Gor'tesh's head on a pike. Now all you have to do is take this head to the top of Dreadmaul Rock and stick it into the ground. Once you do that, watch as those cowardly ogres run for their lives! After you've had your fun, come back to me and I'll reward you for all of your hard work.
rows.quest:3825:details:2: B<Oralius seems to be losing touch with reality.>
rows.quest:3825:completion:0: Outstanding work, soldier! Simply amazing! Oh I'll get the medal of bravery for this, er, I mean you'll be rewarded handsomely for this!
rows.quest:4022:obj:0: Show Cyrus Therepentous the Black Dragonflight Molt you received from Kalaran Windblade.⟦10⟧
rows.quest:4022:details:0: The flight is aware of your work in the ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:4022:details:1: BShow it to me, ⟦11⟧. The molt, imbecile.
rows.quest:4022:completion:1: BYou have proven that you are not entirely useless, mortal.
rows.quest:4023:obj:0: Show Cyrus Therepentous proof of your worth.
rows.quest:4023:obj:1: BYou have a feeling that Cyrus already knows that you are unworthy.
rows.quest:4023:details:0: You seek out the Flight? Present to me proof of your worth, mortal.
rows.quest:4023:completion:1: BYou have proven that you are not entirely useless, mortal.
rows.quest:4061:obj:0: Venture to the ⟦E1⟧ and recover 10 Fractured Elemental Shards for Hierophant Theodora Mulvadania.
rows.quest:4061:obj:1: BYou recall Theodora mentioning the golems and elementals of that region as being a source for these shards.
rows.quest:4061:details:0: The machines made themselves known to us during our initial forays into the ⟦E2⟧. Upon further investigation we discovered that they were being imported from ⟦E1⟧, possibly Blackrock Depths. That is what we need you for, ⟦14⟧.
rows.quest:4061:details:1: BYour first task is to venture to the ⟦E1⟧ and recover elemental shards from the rock automatons and lesser rock creations of the region. Once you have collected a sufficient amount, return to me and I shall determine their source of origin.⟦15⟧
rows.quest:4061:completion:0: <Theodora lays the fragments out before her.>
rows.quest:4061:completion:1: B<Theodora carefully examines the fragments with an enormous monocle.>
rows.quest:4061:completion:2: BInteresting. Etched into the structural foundation of each of these fragments are... initials.
rows.quest:4182:obj:0: Slay 15 Black Broodlings, 10 Black Dragonspawn, 4 Black Wyrmkin and 1 Black Drake. Return to Helendis Riverhorn when the task is complete.
rows.quest:4182:details:0: Life in the ⟦E1⟧ is rife with conflict.
rows.quest:4182:details:1: BJust look at this place! We know very little of what happened to these buildings, but we do know that at one time, before the great explosion, this was all part of the Redridge mountain range.
rows.quest:4182:details:2: BEnough lamenting! We have a problem, ⟦16⟧. You may have noticed the dragonkin below this ridge. We need assistance in pushing them back. Kill as many as you can and return to me. Succeed and perhaps we can talk of other things.⟦17⟧
rows.quest:4182:completion:0: Superb slaying, ⟦18⟧. Now that we know you can handle yourself around dragonkin, we can talk of more pressing matters.
rows.quest:4183:obj:0: ⟦E3⟧ to Lakeshire and deliver Helendis Riverhorn's Letter to Magistrate ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:4183:details:0: We had always assumed that the Blackrock orcs were a product of their savage upbringing. What we have found here, in their homeland, tells us another story.
rows.quest:4183:details:1: BIndeed, it is bloodlust and thirst for conflict that empowers them, but the black dragonflight are the beings whom control the orcs of Blackrock. We suspect that it is the black dragonflight that fuels them with rage and hostility.
rows.quest:4183:details:2: BTake this letter to Magistrate ⟦E4⟧. He will know what must be done.
rows.quest:4183:details:3: B<Helendis hands you a sealed letter.>
rows.quest:4183:completion:0: <Magistrate ⟦E4⟧ opens the sealed letter from Helendis and begins reading.>
rows.quest:4184:obj:0: ⟦E3⟧ to ⟦E5⟧ and deliver ⟦E4⟧'s Plea to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon.
rows.quest:4184:details:0: This is grim news, ⟦19⟧. To discover that our mortal enemies are merely pawns of a much greater threat is disheartening. There is no possible way that Lakeshire could survive an attack from both the Blackrock orcs and the black dragonflight. Should Lakeshire fall to this menace, Darkshire would fall next, and then what? Goldshire? ⟦E5⟧ itself?
rows.quest:4184:details:1: BYou must take this information to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon in ⟦E5⟧ at once! If this does not merit the aid of ⟦E5⟧, nothing will and all is lost.⟦20⟧
rows.quest:4185:obj:0: Speak with Highlord Bolvar Fordragon after speaking with Lady Katrana Prestor.
rows.quest:4185:details:0: ⟦E4⟧ paints a dreary picture. Still, we cannot afford to send our thinly spread troops to the aid of Lakeshire on speculation. I will need proof of these claims before I can act.
rows.quest:4185:details:1: BSpeak with Lady Prestor, ⟦21⟧. She is a learned woman and knows much of dragons and dragonkin. She may be able to shed some light on this situation.⟦22⟧
rows.quest:4185:completion:0: <Bolvar cups his chin as if in deep thought.>
rows.quest:4185:completion:1: BWhile I respect Lady Prestor's stance, I believe that there is a solution to this dilemma that may put all of our concerns to rest.
rows.quest:4186:obj:0: Take Bolvar's Decree to Magistrate ⟦E4⟧ in Lakeshire.⟦23⟧
rows.quest:4186:details:0: I am going to empower you as an acting deputy of ⟦E5⟧, ⟦24⟧.
rows.quest:4186:details:1: BReturn to Magistrate ⟦E4⟧ in Lakeshire and deliver this decree.
rows.quest:4186:completion:0: It could have been worse, I suppose...
rows.quest:4186:completion:2: BIt appears as if the fate of Lakeshire rests squarely on your shoulders.
rows.quest:4186:completion:3: B<You notice Magistrate ⟦E4⟧ blinking rapidly. He appears to be crying.>
rows.quest:4223:obj:0: Speak with Marshal Maxwell in the ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:4223:details:1: BYou must return to the ⟦E1⟧, ⟦26⟧. As a deputy of ⟦E5⟧, you will be required to report to Marshal Maxwell. Good luck.
rows.quest:4224:obj:0: Speak with Ragged John to learn of Marshal Windsor's fate and return to Marshal Maxwell when you have completed this task.
rows.quest:4224:obj:1: BYou recall Marshal Maxwell telling you to search for him in a cave to the north.
rows.quest:4224:details:0: What? You thought you were the first? How many soldiers must we lose before ⟦E5⟧ acts?
rows.quest:4224:details:1: BWe had accumulated enormous amounts of intelligence pertaining to the Blackrock menace before we lost our commanding officer, Marshal Windsor. With Marshal Windsor went all of our precious information.
rows.quest:4224:details:2: BWhat we need is that documentation. Speak with Ragged John, ⟦28⟧. He was with Windsor when they were attacked by a Blackrock raiding party. He was last seen in a cave to the north.
rows.quest:4224:completion:0: I could have warned you, but what fun is that?
rows.quest:4283:obj:0: Oralius wants 50 Blackrock Medallions. Chances are high that these medallions can be found on the orcs in the ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:4283:details:0: I'm going to let you in on a little secret, soldier. Come a little closer.
rows.quest:4283:details:1: BI'M THE ONLY SANE ONE HERE!
rows.quest:4283:details:2: BLook at these people! Would you believe that they're all insane!? Well they are! NUTS! CRAZY!
rows.quest:4283:details:4: BLet's just keep that between me, you, and my pal Captain Winky.
rows.quest:4283:details:5: B<Oralius grabs at the air and squeezes.>
rows.quest:4283:details:6: BAnyhooooo... I'm collecting badges to go along with my ogre ear collection. Orc is the flavor of the day. Fifty. GO!
rows.quest:4283:completion:0: You've done it! Your reward is: RUB MY BELLY! GO ON! RUB IT!
rows.quest:4296:obj:0: Bring the Tablet Transcript to Maxwort Uberglint in the ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:4296:details:0: I came to the ⟦E1⟧, following the legends of the Seven. They were dwarves of great knowledge and power, and if you have knowledge and power, then wealth is sure to follow.
rows.quest:4296:details:2: BIf we can learn more of the Seven, then maybe we can get rich together. The ruins of Thaurissan is rumored to keep the Tablet of the Seven, which holds knowledge of the ancient dwarves. Find this tablet, copy its text and bring it to me. Let's discover its secrets together!
rows.quest:4296:completion:0: Ah, you found the tablet! And your transcription is superb! Are you sure you're a ⟦31⟧ and not a scribe?
rows.quest:4296:completion:1: BHere you are, ⟦32⟧. Here is the payment I promised.
rows.quest:4726:obj:0: Bring 8 Broodling Essence and the Draco-Incarcinatrix 900 to Tinkee Steamboil at the Flame Crest in the ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:4726:details:0: I have been studying the dragonkin of the ⟦E1⟧ for weeks, and I think I've finally had a breakthrough! I created a device--I call it the Draco Incarcinatrix 900. It can capture the essence of dragon whelp broodlings!
rows.quest:4726:details:1: BOr, at least I think it can.
rows.quest:4726:details:2: BHere, take the device and zap a broodling in the ⟦E1⟧ with it. While it's under the device's effects, defeat the broodling and its essence should be released.
rows.quest:4726:details:3: BIf it is, then splendid! Bring me back samples so I can study them!
rows.quest:4726:completion:0: It worked! You got the essence! Well done, ⟦33⟧! Well done!
rows.quest:4726:completion:1: BThis essence will be invaluable in my research. I hope to one day learn how to capture living dragons whelps, or perhaps capture their eggs. If I could find a way to do that, then I would be the envy of dragon scholars around the world!
rows.quest:4726:completion:2: BMy employer would also be happy, and as I said before, he's someone you want to keep happy...
rows.quest:4808:obj:0: Give Tinkee's Letter to Felnok Steelspring.
rows.quest:4808:details:0: I have another favor to ask of you.
rows.quest:4808:details:1: BMy initial study of the essence you collected shows that it might be possible to freeze dragon whelp eggs and preserve them! I want to test this theory, but first I need specially made engineering components. My colleague, Felnok Steelspring, can make them.
rows.quest:4808:details:2: BHere, take this letter to Felnok. It tells him what I need. You'll find Felnok in ⟦E6⟧, in the town of ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:4808:completion:0: That's no blanket! But what have we here? I letter from Tinkee? I wonder what she has to say...
rows.quest:4808:completion:1: BAh, she's studying in the ⟦E1⟧. That makes sense--that's a good source for dragonkin. Oh, but look! It says here that she needs some parts for a device she wants to build. I guess that's where I come in, eh?
rows.quest:5522:obj:0: Bring the Frozen Eggs to Leonid Barthalomew in the ⟦E8⟧.
rows.quest:5522:details:0: I received a message from my master, Vectus. Well, the message wasn't really from Vectus...it was from someone named Leonid Barthalomew. I don't know Leonid, but he knew my master, and no one knows my master unless he allows it.
rows.quest:5522:details:1: BLeonid says Vectus wants the dragon eggs. He wants you to deliver them to him at the Light's ⟦E9⟧ Chapel in the ⟦E8⟧.
rows.quest:5522:details:2: BThat hurts! Why you? Doesn't Vectus trust me? Oh, never mind... just take the eggs and tell Leonid that I did what our master commanded.
rows.quest:5522:completion:0: Ah, very good. You do not know the evil power for whom you have labored, but now you will know the truth. And fear not--I am no servant of that master. I am Leonid Barthalomew, known as "the Revered" to my brethren in the Argent Dawn.
rows.quest:5522:completion:1: BI tricked Tinkee into sending you and the dragon eggs to me. And it is good that my trick was successful, for had these eggs reached their intended destination, a great power would have fallen into the hands of the enemy.
